state:
**Goal `growth-proof`, Stage 3 closed; Stage 4 is next.** No floor is carried.

Every flat bench's N is twice the batch its ramp settled at: `bun nv scaling --iterations --sized --lower` rewrote them, and `--sized` alone passes. A bench the ramp skips keeps its N (`withBatch` cannot rewrite its closing line, or N is too small to ramp).

A record's count per operation is now the ramp's last increment (`measureOne` in `tools/nv/proofs/perf.ts`), so set-up cancels and N moves no count; a declaration is met within a hundredth or one count across the last window. Every bench was re-recorded at its new N in `docs/perf/members.ndjson`.

`bun nv scaling --budget` counts the statements each bench runs at its N against `docs/perf/bench-budget.json`; `--write` stores them. It passes, and two runs give the same total.

**The clock at the lowered N mostly reads 0:** most of the new records have `ns_per_op 0.0`, because the work is below the start-up floor's noise. The counts are intact. Whether the clock should be timed at a larger, clock-only N is the user's call, and nothing has been changed for it.

next.title: a change reruns the benches it reaches

items.text: **A `bench` atom.** Add the kind `bench` to `tools/nv/select/atoms.ts:6` (the kinds table): one bench under `benches/members/`, defined by the bench, its `.scale.nvs`, `.in` and `.nvsr`, its footprint from one recording run at the smallest batch, as `tools/nv/select/atoms.ts:119` (`proofPrograms`) takes an example's. Pin it in `tools/nv/test/bench-selection.test.ts`, the check `a change selects the benches it reaches, and only those`. Spec: the goal's Stage 4.

**The record.** The Stage 4 decision record (the next free ADR) modifying `rule:testing/member-perf-ledger` (`docs/rules/testing/member-perf-ledger.md:1`): a figure is current while no item its bench's footprint holds has moved.
**`nv affected` names the benches.** `tools/nv/cmd/affected.ts` lists the benches a change reaches, and `--run` reruns their perf proof at their N (`tools/nv/proofs/perf.ts:136`, `measureOne`).

backlog: The benches the ramp skips keep their large N and hold most of the budget (`lang/programs/*` run millions of statements each): make their closing line rampable (`tools/nv/cmd/scaling.ts:191`, `withBatch`), then `--sized --lower` and `--budget --write`. Goal Stage 3.
The zero clock figures above: the user's decision, then `tools/nv/proofs/perf.ts:136` if it changes.
Item 4 of the old group, the `--growth` sweep, was covered by the forced re-record: every bench's growth was judged and none fails.
Stage 5 (skip what is proven) and Stage 6 (`## The growth proof` in `docs/perf/performance-pass.md`) follow Stage 4.
